answer: Random peer audit checks a sybil flood like a river at crossings. Each new identity is a vertex in an audit graph with five random peers, funded by a 150 POA deposit it stakes. Auditors check its work and counterparties; a fake cluster looks like a nebula of lookalike vertices with no real trade, so its deposit burns; auditors split a 20 POA fee. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 150 = 15,000 POA, while an honest agent pays once and trades on.
